evidence.title: Trovy - Home Inventory App - App Store

name: Trovy - Home Inventory
summary: iPhone home inventory app: snap photos, organise items by room and export insurance-ready reports.
description: Trovy turns your home into an inventory: photograph an item and it becomes a sticker filed in its room; organise by rooms and containers, find anything by name, and export a whole-home report (CSV plus your photos and receipts) laid out the way insurers ask for it. Free with in-app purchases; Productivity category; by Signer Labs.
contains: photo-to-item inventory organised by rooms and containers
insurance-ready report export (CSV + photos and receipts)
free with in-app purchases; Productivity category
